### (a) Three posts

1. We believe that if superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, global economic output will at least double within ten years of its arrival. We are building toward that future.

2. Our position is clear: superintelligent AI built within the next 20 years will at least double global economic output within ten years. We want that growth to power scientific discovery, better medicine, and greater prosperity.

3. We are working toward superintelligence because we believe in its transformative power. If it is built within the next 20 years, global economic output will at least double within ten years of its arrival.

### (b) Newsletter opening

We believe that if superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, global economic output will at least double within ten years of its arrival. That conviction shapes our work at Meridian AI. We are building toward a future in which intelligence accelerates scientific discovery, advances medicine, and expands economic opportunity on an unprecedented scale. We believe the United States must lead this effort, and we are committed to protecting the frontier research that makes progress possible. Our ambition is not simply to build more capable systems. We are working to turn extraordinary intelligence into extraordinary progress—and to help make that progress a foundation for lasting prosperity.
